status: Pre-E5-result specification; complete source, inputs, schedules and initialization must be frozen before training/evaluation
scope: Sequential exploratory follow-up after E3/E4 on already exposed development events. This is neither a fresh confirmatory benchmark nor a historical E2 training replay.
question: Can training from initialization without explicit difference tokens preserve the current source-label discrimination at the same training budget, and how does it compare with removing the difference block only after full-input training?
trigger: E3 zero-D interventions yielded all-no, including A/B retained. E4 D-only preserved much source signal but met the preregistered sufficiency rule in only one of three seeds (mixed/inconclusive). No E5 outputs existed when this plan was specified.

population.order: Preserve C0-v1 items.jsonl bytes and item order. ordered_ids partitions that fixed order; row pair_index is the global zero-based item index. Do not claim this order matches historical E2.
population.eligibility: Use every frozen C0 eligible item and every pinned cache. Missing, changed or nonfinite input invalidates preparation; no exclusion/reselection.
population.partition_checks: No shared IDs/tiles between train and test; flood train27/test10 events and landslide train7/test2 regions disjoint.

pool_reproduction.comparison: bitwise array equality of newly pooled matching item IDs against E4 frozen pairs

inputs.pooling: Exact E2 CPU torch avg_pool2d: Sentinel-1 fp16 (3,768,48,48) pooled6, Sentinel-2 fp16 (12,768,32,32) pooled4; fixed C0 indices, no global feature averaging.
inputs.zero_blocks: A zero EO value block still passes through projector bias, normalization and type embeddings. It is not removal of token positions.
inputs.prompt: Same source question, sensor, phenomenon, date strings and yes/no answer tokenization in every condition. Save exact user/chat strings and prefix/suffix/answer IDs for all items.
inputs.flood_dates: Known event-derived approximations also embedded by encoder, not independently verified acquisition timestamps.

training.model: Frozen Olmo-3-7B-Instruct, same projector architecture as E2: 768->2048 GELU->hidden, type embedding4 initialized normalstd.02, input/output LayerNorm, scalar gain.
training.initialization: For each seed, create one common projector initial state and copy it into each of the four conditions; record canonical tensor hash before every training. Fresh AdamW state for each model. No E2/E4 learned projector is used as initialization.
training.data_order: Precompute exactly three sequential numpy default_rng(seed).permutation(4234) orders, batch8 with finalbatch2, store complete ID batches. All arms in a seed use identical stored schedules.
training.precision: Projector float32, frozen LLM bfloat16, same E2 answer+EOS labels/right padding/attention mask; LLM eval mode but gradients flow to projected input.
training.fixed_budget: No early stopping, loss-based or test-based epoch selection, rebalancing, LR sweep, extra warmup/probe updates, or result-dependent retry. Evaluate final epoch only.
training.log: Record each optimizer step loss, batch identity, cumulative example exposure, finite checks and elapsed time; save model and initial-state hashes.

evaluation.native: All1755 test items under each of12 trained models native arm.
evaluation.full_no_delta: Each of3 newly trained full models also evaluates all1755 testitems with pair inputs, without training or new labels. This is an explicit frozen intervention, not a fifth trained model.
evaluation.decode: Greedy max_new_tokens16; same yes/no parser; record raw answers and generation validity checks.
evaluation.no_pseudogold: No transformed physical-scene labels are assigned. Native results also retain explicit source_gold provenance.

primary_analysis.population: Frozen C1 symmetric-quality, supported same(event,dates,slots) pos-versus-hard strata:445pos457hard902items8events. Rebuild from pinned quality records, not model outputs.
primary_analysis.metric: Balanced source-label agreement per same-prompt stratum; equal stratum mean within each event, equal event mean. Unparsed answers count incorrect.

bootstrap.unit: whole paired event, preserving all conditions within event

primary_analysis.pair_preserves_source_discrimination_at_: In at least2/3 same seeds, full and pair macroBA>=.60 and pair-full CI lower>=-.05; at least5 supported events.
primary_analysis.explicit_difference_helps_at_this_budget: If preservation not met: in at least2/3 same seeds with full macroBA>=.60, pair-full point<=-.10 and CIupper<0.
primary_analysis.mixed_or_inconclusive: Otherwise. Neither a null superiority test nor similar point estimates establish equivalence.
primary_analysis.margin_rationale: Retain the .05 noninferiority tolerance and .10 substantial-loss thresholds from the earlier exploratory E3/E4 planning, fixed before E5 outcomes. These are diagnostic operational margins, not a domain-validated decision-cost threshold.
primary_analysis.seed_handling: Seeds are repeated model fits on the same events, not additional independent events. Report all seeds and require same-seed conjunctions.

secondary_descriptive.paired_flood: Original457pos/457pre-pre negative source pairs over10events, equal event BA; report separately from primary902.
secondary_descriptive.hard_negatives: 457 source hard-negative items, event/pooledFPR and parsecounts, kept distinct from paired negatives.
secondary_descriptive.landslide: Hiroshima186/Indonesia6 pairedtiles, region means only; no unseen-region generalization claim.
secondary_descriptive.recovery: Compare pair-trained to newly full-trained then no-delta-intervened outputs. Descriptive evidence about training-format mismatch; does not automatically establish temporal reasoning.
secondary_descriptive.all_items: All1755 predictions are retained, including primary-ineligible and unsupported items, with explicit membership.

validity.coverage: Exactly12 completed1590-update/12702-exposure trainings, same initwithinseed and schedule; exactly26325 unique expected outputs; no train IDs in evaluation; original metadata/gold unchanged.
validity.finite: Selected caches/pooled/source/transform/projector/checkpoints/loss/gradients/parameters finite; generation scores have noNaN/+Inf and at leastonefinite value.
validity.freeze: Pin original C0/C1/E4 metadata, live source QA/cache/model bytes, prepared pairs/order/batches/evalsets/source/prereg before training. Execute the frozen source snapshot.
validity.failure: Stop chain and preserve partial outputs as execution-invalid. No silentresume, exclusion, budget/threshold adaptation or replacement of failed seeds.

compute.expected_walltime: About2–3.5hours plus CPU preparation, extrapolated from historical E2; not guaranteed.
compute.launch: Only idle authorized GPU0, inherited cooperative locks, manifestSHA/UUID/FD identity checks. No foreign job interruption. No parallel E5 variants.

limits: Already exposed development data and sequential hypothesis selection; no fresh confirmatory evidence.
Source flood labels and pre/pre absence assumptions do not supply independently verified temporal-change gold.
C1 controls prompt/date/quality strata but not all background, permanent-water or acquisition differences.
Synthetic dates remain in both prompt and encoder. Later-only success cannot establish pure visual-semantic understanding.
D=B-A contains both source observations; delta success does not mean history is unnecessary.
Input-format comparisons under a fixed learning budget measure practical learnability/discriminability, not fundamental information-theoretic necessity.
Two phenomena remain confounded with sensors, and landslide region support is highly imbalanced.
No memory-system benefit, causal impact, current damage, or CVPR-level method contribution follows automatically from any verdict.
next_step: Use the predefined result and validity outcomes to choose one further scientific test; do not continue modifying thresholds or looking for favorable seeds. Pair preservation/recovery would motivate trustworthy grounding and verified temporal labels; failures require diagnosing learnability and evidence rather than assuming memory bottleneck.
